literal: people of the world / exists / that which is said / does not exist / he who says / in the world / as a demon / to be placed / will be
translation: He who denies what the people of the world affirm to exist, will be considered a demon on earth.
modern: உலகத்து உயர்ந்தோர் உண்டு என்று சொல்வதை இல்லை என்று மறுப்பவன், இந்த உலகத்தில் ஒரு பேயாகவே கருதப்படுவான்.
explanation: This couplet describes the extreme folly of denying universal truths. When a person stubbornly rejects what the wise people of the world ('உலகத்தார்') collectively affirm to exist ('உண்டு என்பது'), he isolates himself from human reason. Because of this unnatural and destructive mindset, he is not seen as a normal human being but is classified as a demon ('அலகையா') wandering the earth. The word 'அலகை' (demon or ghost) emphasizes his alienation from human society and common sense.
